notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Chain 12 / 90 ring / 10 / 90 ring / 23 / 35 = 260 (35 = top of the legend to the bottom edge: 20 D + 15). ON FOOTPATH panel across the bottom: black border 3 inside a 3 white edge (3 / 6), outer y 212-257 measured; ON FOOTPATH 20 D, top 225, overall ink 174 (25/174/26; word gap not stated, set so the pair spans 174: 14.3; measured 15). Three red prohibition rings 90 dia (ring and slash 7.5 wide, measured — not dimensioned; slash from upper right to lower left over the symbol): skateboard on top (centred, 67.5/90/67.5), in-line skate and scooter below (15 / 90 / 15 / 90 / 15, the sheet's 98 | 98 from the ring edges to the sign's centre line).
